summary: Fit a contour path and provide arclength, field-interpolation, gradient, curvature, and bounded-intersection diagnostics.

capability: Fit a contour path and provide arclength, field interpolation, gradient, curvature and bounded-intersection diagnostics.
operation: contour label and vertices to a fitted diagnostic line
psi contour label and ordered planar vertices -> fitted line object with geometry and field diagnostics
discovery.model: Quadratic default parametric spline with selectable grid interpolation, a local polynomial curvature derivative, and a separate uniform-grid flux-gradient curvature path.
discovery.geometry: Open paths preserve order and closed paths use periodic splprep; planar R,Z in caller length units with psi as a contour label.
discovery.boundary: Intersections are searched only over fitted parameter intervals and zero or multiple crossings are rejected; arbitrary topology, magnetic-axis limits and certification are excluded.

identity.direction: contour label and vertices to a fitted diagnostic object
identity.definition: Fit an ordered parametric line; field curvature differentiates normalized interpolated BR,BZ along the fitted geometry.
identity.model: Quadratic default spline, selectable grid interpolation, local polynomial curvature derivative, and a separate uniform-grid flux-gradient curvature path.
identity.geometry: Open paths preserve order; closed paths use periodic splprep.
identity.coordinates: Planar R,Z in caller length units; psi is a contour label.
identity.boundary: Intersections search only the fitted parameter intervals and reject zero or multiple crossings.
assumptions: Finite vertices are sufficient for splprep and adjacent fitted samples remain distinct.
Field curvature needs finite nonzero B and nonzero tangent projection.
Flux-gradient curvature needs a finite separable uniform grid with nonzero gradient.

inputs.name: verts
inputs.constraints: Finite ordered points sufficient for the default quadratic splprep fit; adjacent fitted samples must remain distinct.

outputs.name: line
outputs.description: Object exposing verts,tck,u and arclength/field diagnostics
outputs.units: length; gradient caller flux per length; curvature inverse length
outputs.constraints: get_ds returns first segment length, not a uniform-step guarantee

preconditions: Finite vertices are sufficient for splprep and adjacent fitted samples remain distinct.
Field curvature needs finite nonzero B and nonzero tangent projection.
supported: Named interpolation, curvature, derivative, boundary, and failure cases in the listed tests.
excluded: Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limits, field-line certification, and universal error bounds.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for undefined curvature support, duplicate vertices, invalid flux grids, or nonfinite interpolation results; other SciPy errors propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Underlying interpolation, linear-algebra, and floating-point exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Intersection raises ValueError when no unique fitted-interval crossing is found; finite multistart search does not prove root completeness.
failure_semantics.partial_results: apply_boundary updates both bounds only after both intersections succeed; failed construction returns no line.

example.description: Fit one open FieldLine from three ordered vertices.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.geometry.fieldline import FieldLine
line=FieldLine(.2,np.array([[.2,0.],[.6,0.],[1.,0.]]))
assert line.verts.shape==(1000,2)
example.expected: The default constructor produces a line with verts shape (1000,2).

scope: Only the explicitly stated finite input domain and named direct/independent installed fixtures

Named fixtures use the 13x9 affine-gradient inputs and the 4e-9 absolute gate. Recorded maximum errors are 1.3323e-15 or less across the two variants. The circle case uses 401 points and spatial grids 40/80/160 on the same domain: field-curvature vector errors are 1.1787063e-5, 1.3972100e-6 and 1.6021077e-7, passing both >3.4 refinement ratios and final <.004 gates. These are named-fixture observations, not universal convergence rates.

A held-out ellipse on 71x83 unequal-spacing grids and 257 line points, including coherent descending coordinates, B reversal and vertex reversal, has maximum component error 1.329318e-7 or less in recorded cases. Boundary cases reject outside support, duplicate vertices, nonfinite fields and actual field nulls. Field-scale tests at signed 1e-180 and 1e180, with a translated geometry, pass unchanged finite-fixture criteria; no arbitrary-dynamic-range guarantee follows.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named-fixture technical evidence for this repository's own tests. It does not establish arbitrary-input correctness, experimental validation or human endorsement.
known_limitations: Intersection is bounded to fitted parameter intervals and rejects no-crossing/multiple-root cases; tangency/completeness remains unqualified
Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limit and physical stability are unqualified
get_kappa_n_2 requires uniform xy grid and nonzero flux gradient
Polar projection is supplied separately with explicit theta and origin failure; magnetic-axis limit remains unqualified.

Refining path samples on a fixed interpolated field need not monotonically improve physical curvature error; four fixed-interpolant refinement cases remain recorded as failures and are distinct from the spatial-grid refinement gate.
Local quartic field-curvature derivatives assume a sufficiently smooth genuine field line. Public d_ds retains its polygonal three-point contract; neither implies a universal curvature-error bound.
